assets.alt_text: Comparison of low, normal, and high kurtosis distributions with tail risk emphasis.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 PNG, 16:9. Educational kurtosis diagram comparing three smooth distributions on the same axis: low kurtosis with flatter center, normal distribution, and high kurtosis with sharp peak and heavier tails. Emphasize both tails with subtle coral shading to connect kurtosis to financial tail risk. Use only short labels: low, normal, high kurtosis. Clean academic vector-like style, off-white background, navy axis, teal and amber curves. Keep a 7% safe margin.

assets.alt_text: Gallery of scatterplots illustrating positive, negative, zero, and nonlinear correlation patterns.
assets.prompt: Create a 2000x1000 PNG, 2:1.
